content: {"question":"For a manager in Mexico who wants to use the Growth and Development Fund to pay for coaching with SoundingBoard, will the expense be tax‑free for the company?","answer":"Yes – a manager can use the G&D Fund to pay SoundingBoard coaching, and the expense will be tax‑free if the employee provides an invoice addressed to Remote’s Mexican legal entity.","evidence_a":"In MX, all these expenses can be non‑taxable, as long as the employee provides an invoice adressed to the employer's local legal entity. (the invoice needs to have the employer's tax number \"RFC\")","evidence_b":"Coaching through the G&D Fund is available to team members at the Manager level and above. If you are seeking coaching, we strongly encourage you to use SoundingBoard Coaching. Because GitLab has a direct relationship with SoundingBoard, you will not need to put the cost on your personal credit card. The charge can be routed directly to the appropriate cost center."}
